commands.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$runPath=Join-Path (Get-Location) '.tmp/1747-current-runtime-20261118b'
$nextReceipt=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'next-process-private.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$controllerReceipt=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'controller2-private.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$browserReceipt=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'browser-process-private.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$processes=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process)
$ownedIds=[System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[int]]::new()
foreach($ownedRoot in @($nextReceipt.parent,$nextReceipt.pid,$controllerReceipt.pid,$browserReceipt.pid)){[void]$ownedIds.Add([int]$ownedRoot)}
for($round=0;$round -lt 10;$round++){foreach($procRow in $processes){if($ownedIds.Contains([int]$procRow.ParentProcessId)){[void]$ownedIds.Add([int]$procRow.ProcessId)}}}
$ownedRows=@($processes | Where-Object {$ownedIds.Contains([int]$_.ProcessId)} | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath,CreationDate,CommandLine)
$ownedRows | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'owned-processes-before-private.json')
$services=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'fixture-private/services.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$serviceRows=@();foreach($service in $services.containers){$serviceName=if($service -is [string]){$service}else{$service.name};$raw=docker inspect $serviceName; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'OWNED_CONTAINER_MISSING'};$row=($raw | ConvertFrom-Json)[0];if($row.Config.Labels.'z8.agent-owned' -ne $services.label){throw 'CONTAINER_LABEL_REFUSAL'};$serviceRows+=@{name=$serviceName;id=$row.Id;label=$services.label;ports=$row.NetworkSettings.Ports}}
$serviceRows | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'owned-services-before-private.json')
@{ownedProcessCount=$ownedRows.Count;ownedServiceCount=$serviceRows.Count;threeExactLabelsVerified=($serviceRows.Count -eq 3);nextParentAndBrowserRecorded=$true;browserAlreadyClosed=$true;fullInventoryPrivate=$true} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'ownership-before-SAFE.json')
Write-Output 'OWNERSHIP_INVENTORY_SAVED'

commands.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$runPath=Join-Path (Get-Location) '.tmp/1747-current-runtime-20261118b'
$serviceRows=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'owned-services-before-private.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$remainingServices=0;foreach($service in $serviceRows){$probe=docker inspect $service.name 2>$null;if($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0){$remainingServices++}}
$ownedRows=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'owned-processes-before-private.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$remainingProcesses=0;foreach($row in $ownedRows){if(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$($row.ProcessId)"){$remainingProcesses++}}
$nextReceipt=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'next-process-private.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$controllerReceipt=Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'controller2-private.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$ownedPorts=[System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[int]]::new();[void]$ownedPorts.Add([int]$nextReceipt.port);[void]$ownedPorts.Add([int]$controllerReceipt.port);foreach($service in $serviceRows){foreach($portProperty in $service.ports.PSObject.Properties){foreach($binding in $portProperty.Value){[void]$ownedPorts.Add([int]$binding.HostPort)}}}
$remainingListeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object {$ownedPorts.Contains([int]$_.LocalPort)})
$markerProcesses=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.ExecutablePath -match '(node|pnpm|chrome)\.exe$' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*1747-current-runtime-20261118b*'})
$profilePath=Join-Path $runPath 'chromium-ephemeral'
@{exactManifestServiceCount=$serviceRows.Count;remainingOwnedServices=$remainingServices;remainingRecordedOwnedProcesses=$remainingProcesses;remainingUniqueRunNodePnpmChromeProcesses=$markerProcesses.Count;ownedPortCount=$ownedPorts.Count;remainingOwnedPortListeners=$remainingListeners.Count;remainingOwnedProfiles=[int](Test-Path -LiteralPath $profilePath);ownedContextsClosed=$true;ownedBrowserClosed=$true;ownedControllerClosed=$true;ownedNextClosed=$true;ownedLiveResources=($remainingServices+$remainingProcesses+$markerProcesses.Count+$remainingListeners.Count+[int](Test-Path -LiteralPath $profilePath));noPeerResourceMutation=$true} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'resources-final-SAFE.json')
Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'resources-final-SAFE.json')
